origin.basis: Challenge says it has roots in Italy, the United States and Thailand (company page).

manufacturing.basis: Challenge says all its handmade tires are made in its family-owned factory in Thailand.

wet_notes.summary: Challenge says the SMARThydro compound improves wet-weather grip; no independent wet test found.

availability.note: Sold by Challenge's US web store; its European storefront was not read for this tire.

name: 4 Stagioni XP TLR
positioning: Challenge's handmade four-season tubeless-ready road tire with the SMARThydro compound and reinforced casing.
hookless_note: Challenge's FAQ lists all handmade TLR tires from 33 to 45C and all Criterium RS TLR sizes as compatible with ISO/ETRTO-compliant hookless rims. The product page calls the model hookless compatible.
protection: Standard, with extra protection under the tread and sidewalls
caveats: Wet grip is a maker claim.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; shipping and tax at checkout.

image.shown: 28 mm tan-wall 4 Stagioni XP TLR, the store's photo for that option; other widths have their own photos.
image.alt: Challenge 4 Stagioni XP TLR road tire with tan sidewalls and siped tread

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-03 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list in a browser (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out.
